description: Read one saved scenario file of the simulation workspace this credential is connected to: the file, checked against the workspace as it stands now, with a plain-language reading of each step and anything that would stop it running. ready=true means run_simulation_scenario will accept the file; pass the scenario to it as JSON text, or to draft_simulation_scenario to revise it.

savedScenarioId.description: The saved scenario's id, from list_saved_simulation_scenarios.

name: get_saved_simulation_scenario
title: Get Saved Simulation Scenario
